notes.title: Major update : FSR and detailed information
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, [/p][p]This update focuses on delivering [b]more detailed results[/b] and ensuring that [b]everything is saved[/b] seamlessly.[/p][p][b]Here’s what’s new:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700729/e5704562c4eaa7b51cfa000d1fcc1946bd0159a3.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Saves are now using [b]Steam Cloud[/b]! For across devices comparison.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]polished result page[/b][/p][/*][*][p]With new information:[/p][list][*][p][b]Resolution[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Percentage rendered[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Antialiasing method[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Highest framerate[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]10 percentile low [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]1 percentile low[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]GPU and CPU spec[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Driver version[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]With a chart showing the framerate history, with average, 10% and 1% lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to [b]copy to clipboard[/b], only the score, or all information.[/p][/*][*][p]All this information is saved and displayed on the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mute / Unmute button[/b], the benchmark now starts muted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]GPU % utilization[/b] on a real time chart (Press SPACE during benchmark)[/p][/*][*][p]AMD's [b]FSR 3.1[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700729/b205eb87c500492f44f024ec746961e0a4c92f2e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700729/28259b209b781f92513c8a8895e415cd1c3750f6.png"][/img][/p][p]The ultimate goal is to have [b]the best and[/b] [b]most useful benchmark [/b]out there[b] [/b](and also most beautiful), with the most amount of information.[/p][p]
Bringing so much more data in the saves, save system has to start over, sorry :([/p][p]I am open to suggestions for more future improvements![/p][p]
Enjoy guys, and [b]thank you for using this benchmark. If you like it, please leave a review![/b]


[/p]

notes.title: Next Visuals Benchmark is now available!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Next Visuals Benchmark[/b] is a tool built with the latest rendering technologies, to show the performance and visual quality of present and future video games.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700729/41f229ec7d5197df304d72d9decda0b3375d46d7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With this benchmark, you get access to cutting-edge graphics while testing your PC for realistic, meaningful results. I made this tool because I personally needed something like it, so I built it for myself, and decided to share it with everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope PC testers and reviewers include its results, so gamers can better understand what to expect from their GPU.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy guys!

[/p]
